thesis: The episode introduces Capital Allocators as a podcast exploring the people and processes behind capital allocation through conversations with industry leaders. It features Daniel Adamson, a senior managing director at Wafra and President of Capital Constellation, a joint venture between large asset owners in Europe, North America, and the Middle East that invests in the next generation of private equity managers.
